components.purpose: The detailed grid below the plans: a heading with a table that compares every feature across all plans, with one Comparison Row item per feature (values for each plan column plus a note). It matches the 'rows as content items' feature-by-plan comparison. PricingTable was rejected because it needs a hand-built features JSON structure that I don't have, and the plans themselves are assumed to already be on the page as PricingCards.
